app.title: SecureShare
app.tagline: Zero-knowledge text sharing — we can't read your pastes.

create.title: Share sensitive text, securely
create.subtitle: Your text is encrypted in your browser before it ever leaves your device. We never see the plaintext, and we never see the key.

placeholder.plain: Paste your secret text here... (optional if attaching a file)

create.discussion_disabled: Cannot enable discussion on a burn-after-read paste

dropzone.text: Drag & drop a file, or click to browse

error.password: Enter a password, or turn off password protection.
error.generic: Something went wrong creating the paste.
error.filesize: File too large — max size is {{size}}.

success.title: Your paste is ready 🔒
success.subtitle: This link contains the decryption key. The server cannot read your paste — only someone with this exact link{{suffix}} can.
success.warn_password: 🔑 Don't forget to share the password separately — it's never included in the URL.
success.warn_burn: ⚠️ This paste will self-destruct after it's opened once.
success.info_discussion: 💬 Anyone with this link can join the discussion.

confirm.title: Someone shared an encrypted paste with you
confirm.subtitle: It will be decrypted locally in your browser. If it's a one-time paste, opening it now will permanently delete it from the server.

password.title: Password required 🔑
password.subtitle: This paste is protected with a password. Enter it to decrypt.

error.title: Unable to open paste
error.not_found: This paste doesn't exist, has expired, or has already been viewed.
error.corrupt: Could not decrypt this paste. The link may be corrupted.
error.no_key: This link is missing its decryption key.

revealed.title: Decrypted paste
revealed.burn: 🔥 This paste has now been permanently deleted from the server.

discussion.title: 💬 Discussion
discussion.subtitle: End-to-end encrypted · auto-refreshes every {{seconds}}s
discussion.empty: No comments yet. Be the first to start the discussion!
discussion.error: Failed to post comment. Please try again.
